answer: The protocol places each new AI identity on a bonding curve that raises the creation fee by a delta proportional to the current count of identities on the ledger’s ledge. When an agent requests a fresh identity, a smart contract requires it to lock a stake that grows as cost = base × (1+α·N), where N is the number of identities created in the current garden‑week; the next (N+1)th identity costs the previous fee plus the incremental delta.
